sql.processStepRequirement.getRequirementsFo: select psr.*, false as archived, ot.operator_type, psrt.process_step_requirement_type, ps.id as parent_id, ps.process_step_name as parent_name, cf.field_name, null as company_function from flow.process_step_requirement psr inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = psr.custom_field_group_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfg.custom_field_id inner join flow.custom_field_group_type cfgt on cfgt.id = cfg.custom_field_group_type_id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = cfgt.process_step_id inner join flow.operator_type ot on ot.id = psr.operator_type_id inner join flow.process_step_requirement_type psrt on psrt.id = psr.process_step_requirement_type_id union all select psr.*, false as archived, ot.operator_type, psrt.process_step_requirement_type, null, null, null, 'Testing' from flow.process_step_requirement psr inner join flow.operator_type ot on ot.id = psr.operator_type_id inner join flow.process_step_requirement_type psrt on psrt.id = psr.process_step_requirement_type_id where psr.company_function_id is not null
sql.processStepRequirement.deleteRequirement: update flow.process_step_requirement set modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_updated = now(), archived = true where id = :requirementId
sql.processStepRequirement.getRequirementTyp: select * from flow.process_step_requirement_type where archived is not true
sql.processStepRequirement.insertRequirement: insert into flow.process_step_requirement(process_step_requirement_type_id, operator_type_id, process_requirement_value, custom_field_group_id, company_function_id, requirement_nbr, date_created, created_by_id) values (:requirementTypeId, :operatorTypeId, :requirementValue, :customFieldGroupId, :companyFunctionId, :requirementNbr, now(), :createdById)
